faq.question: How do I index a new document into CloudScale AI?
faq.answer: Upload the document using the UI Knowledge base section or send a POST request with multipart form-data to http://localhost:8080/api/rag/file.

faq.question: Where is company data stored?
faq.answer: All documents and vector embeddings are stored locally in the self-hosted PostgreSQL PGVector database on port 5433 (ragdb) and never transmitted to external cloud providers.
